expected_findings.description: The comment structure above the two conditional blocks could mislead readers about whether Q1-excluded fixtures still contribute to Q4.
Raw-count values are only tested for key presence rather than actual values, which weakens the test's ability to detect silent count-zeroing bugs.
The test does not verify Q1 pool content beyond n_diffs, such as checking that paired_by_fixture contains exactly the expected fixture IDs.
